items.title: MECH-332 E3 commitment-gate calibration pilot (Pathway-2 readiness; autopsy V3-EXQ-878)
items.note: Governance-ratified calibration pilot (autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-878_2026-08-03, routing user-confirmed 2026-08-03 and applied to MECH-332's evidence_quality_note in claims.yaml). The 878 run left MECH-332 Pathway 2 (commitment-gated PAG/RVM descending suppression -- SD-021, now subsumed by SD-032c; AICAnalog) UNTESTED: n_committed_steps=0 vs floor=8 across all 3 seeds in both AIC-active arms because E3's commitment gate (MECH-090 BetaGate) never elevated during eval. Diagnosis: environment/schedule calibration gap (test-design), NOT substrate_ceiling. This diagnostic finds the training schedule that reliably clears N_COMMITTED_FLOOR=8, before the 878b full-dissociation re-run. Work-graph class: complex (probe-gated) / puzzle (known rules). DESIGN: single-axis TRAINING-BUDGET sweep (S0=180 baseline / S1=360 / S2=540 eps) x 2 AIC-active arms (ARM_AIC_ONLY, ARM_BOTH) x 3 seeds (42,7,13); n_committed_steps as its own pass/fail gate; records running_variance vs commit_threshold (0.40) as the direct predictor. DEVIATION from the autopsy's three named axes (with stated reason): sweep is training-budget ONLY (eval length + arena fixed) because the 878 manifest's own n_fresh_select_ticks (76-331 per cell) proves eval EXPOSURE was not the limiter -- the variance gate was (rv inits 0.5 > 0.40 and converges below the bar only when the world model is trained). If even 3x fails, that informative negative reopens the other axes and points at world-model convergence / the gate itself (label commitment_gate_not_budget_limited), NOT another budget bump. Second deviation: eval uses the agent's own policy throughout (no scripted hazard-forcing) since Pathway 1's efference trials are not measured here (autopsy spec #3: Pathway 1's D2 result is already valid, not re-tested). MEASUREMENT HARDENING (autopsy spec #2): z_harm_s_ratio's empty-committed-sample fallback is None (null), NOT the legacy 1.0 -- so a zero-commitment run fails loudly. This makes SD-021's own historical FAILs V3-EXQ-325b and V3-EXQ-325f (bit-identical s_ratio_D=1.0000 / s_ratio_C=1.0000) SUSPECT: both are indistinguishable from a pure zero-commitment artifact and should be re-checked against their n_committed on review. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is n_committed_steps under a HIGHER training budget than any recorded run (878 ran only 180 eps, got 0); not recoverable post-hoc -> run needed. DV-SYMMETRY: the DV (n_committed_steps = count of E3 ticks with running_variance < commit_threshold) is not invariant under any additive-constant/monotone-rescale/permutation symmetry of the training-budget manipulation -- more training genuinely lowers running_variance, which the count reads directly; not a fixed arithmetic identity. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-332 is a fresh claim with one prior autopsy (the 878 instrument/test-design category, owes no build) -> below threshold, no brake. SCOPE: clears ONLY the commitment-gate calibration blocker (a cheaper, independent blocker that binds first); does NOT resolve the deeper MECH-309/MECH-439 monostrategy precondition on the drive-regime-divergence half of the test (see evidence/planning/sd021_sd032c_mech439_blocker_crossref_staged_2026-08-08.md). diagnostic purpose -> excluded from confidence scoring; claim tags are context. items.title: MECH-025: action-doing mode DV redesign (C1 sign reversed per Thura & Cisek 2014 convergence; precision-ratio demoted to non-gating descriptive metric)
items.note: Finishes the routing from the confirmed failure_autopsy_mech025-cluster-876-671b_2026-08-03 (chip-20260808-mech025-doing-mode-dv-redesign; 5+ days unqueued). V3-EXQ-876 was the first fair V3 test of MECH-025 (all 3 prior instrument defects fixed, both regimes well-sampled/non-degenerate in every seed) but its C1 criterion (doing_mode_delta > 0.002) FAILed with the OPPOSITE sign in 4/5 seeds; autopsy classified this measurement_test_design_defect/non_contributory because the claim's own cited literature disputes C1's sign convention (Friston 2013: precision is continuous, not a discrete mode switch -- flags C1's whole discrete-split framing as a formal-import mismatch; Thura & Cisek 2014, Neuron, the closer biological reference: PMd/M1 representations CONVERGE, not diverge, during commitment -- predicting a SMALLER causal-signature contrast under commitment, i.e. the negative delta V3-EXQ-876 actually observed). claims.yaml's what_would_answer (2026-08-08 digestion) offered two redesign directions: (1) flip C1's sign per Thura-Cisek, or (2) gate on precision_committed_mean vs precision_uncommitted_mean directly (already recorded in 876, separating 4-5 orders of magnitude every seed, never scored). THIS SCRIPT TAKES (1) AS THE LOAD-BEARING CRITERION AND DEMOTES (2) TO NON-GATING: E3's commit rule is LITERALLY committed=running_variance<threshold, precision=1/variance, so 'committed steps have higher precision' is a near-tautological consequence of the substrate's OWN definition of commitment (ARC-016, already independently stable/validated), not an independently falsifiable prediction of MECH-025 -- gating on it risks a structurally-guaranteed vacuous_pass. Direction (1)'s causal_sig, by contrast, is computed from two genuinely independent E2.world_forward rollouts (actual vs a distinct randomly-sampled counterfactual action) through E3.harm_eval and is not wired to the commit rule's own variance computation at all (DV-symmetry: not a broadcast constant, not a monotone rescale of a shared upstream quantity -- see module docstring for the full declaration). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py --readout precision_committed_mean --claim MECH-025 found exactly ONE compatible manifest (v3_exq_876_..._20260802T214005Z_v3, substrate_hash 5bba8a67...) and its doing_mode_delta values are ALREADY KNOWN to this authoring session (negative in 4/5 seeds) -- reusing/reanalyzing that same data under a reversed-sign criterion would be circular (HARKing) regardless of whether done via a formal reanalysis or a relabeled rerun. NOT reused: this script runs FRESH SEEDS (11,17,29,53,71 -- disjoint from 876's [42,123,7,99,256]; none is 44, the documented reef-config instability seed) through the UNCHANGED, already-validated instrument (same SelectionResult.committed read, same agent.update_residue()-every-tick call, same BreathOscillator config) so the reversed criterion is tested against genuinely new data. C1's magnitude (0.002) is carried over UNCHANGED from 876's own pre-registered bar (only the sign flips) -- not fit to the observed effect sizes (-0.03 to -0.09, ~10-40x larger), leaving real room for the fresh run to fail too. RECORDING FIX: 876's write_flat_manifest(...,config=None,...) gap (flagged in the autopsy) is fixed here (full REEConfig passed via dataclasses.asdict, started_at wired for elapsed_seconds, z_goal_stream_stats via ZGoalStreamAccumulator). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag MECH-025 (the one confirmed autopsy is measurement_test_design_defect, action=none) -- not braked. Substrate readiness (2.5): ARC-016 stable/V3-confirmed (dynamic E3 precision), all 6 depends_on claims unblocked, confirmed via claims.yaml + ree-v3/CLAUDE.md ARC-016 sections. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue.json entries with substrate_paths set at all. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 warnings across every category. Smoke PASS (--dry-run, seed 11, 5/3/30 toy schedule): ran clean, no crash, correct P0-unready self-route at toy scale (expected, not load-bearing), progress lines (ep N/M) + verdict line + precision_ratio all emit correctly.
